hf: HF is a grey tetravalent metallic element that resembles zirconium chemically and is found in zirconium minerals.
HF can also mean 3 to 30 megahertz.
HF means the same as hafnium or atomic number 72 or high frequency.
hfc: HFC is a fluorocarbon emitted as a by-product of industrial manufacturing.
HFC means the same as hydrofluorocarbon.
